description: This file defines the singleton repository `ShopRepository` which manages product catalog, cart state, favorites, and user preferences for an online shopping platform. It provides in-memory mock data, live data observables for UI binding, and persistence via local storage.

classes.name: ShopRepository.CatalogPreferences
classes.description: Data class representing user's catalog filter and sort preferences.

classes.name: ShopRepository.CatalogQuery
classes.description: Data class defining parameters for catalog querying, including filter, search, sort, and favorites filter.

classes.name: ShopRepository.PagedProducts
classes.description: Data class representing a page of product results with pagination info.

classes.name: ShopRepository.CartItem
classes.description: Data class representing an item in the shopping cart with product details and quantity.

methods.name: ShopRepository.initialize
methods.description: Initializes the repository, restoring persistent state from local storage, to be called early in app startup.

methods.name: ShopRepository.getCategories
methods.description: Returns the list of product categories.

methods.name: ShopRepository.getAllProducts
methods.description: Returns all mock products.

methods.name: ShopRepository.findProductById
methods.description: Finds a product in the mock data by its ID.

methods.name: ShopRepository.getCategoryName
methods.description: Returns the category name for a given category ID.

methods.name: ShopRepository.cartLiveData
methods.description: Provides a LiveData object representing the current shopping cart state.

methods.name: ShopRepository.addToCart
methods.description: Adds a specified quantity of a product to the cart.

methods.name: ShopRepository.setQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity for a specific product in the cart, removing it if quantity <= 0.

methods.name: ShopRepository.clearCart
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart.

methods.name: ShopRepository.cartItems
methods.description: Returns a list of CartItem objects representing current cart contents.

methods.name: ShopRepository.cartTotalCents
methods.description: Calculates the total price of items in the cart in cents.

methods.name: ShopRepository.getRecentSearches
methods.description: Returns a list of recent search queries.

methods.name: ShopRepository.recordSearchQuery
methods.description: Records a search query, maintaining a capped, most-recent-first list.

methods.name: ShopRepository.clearRecentSearches
methods.description: Clears the recent searches list.

methods.name: ShopRepository.isFavorite
methods.description: Checks if a product ID is marked as favorite.

methods.name: ShopRepository.toggleFavorite
methods.description: Toggles the favorite status of a product ID.

methods.name: ShopRepository.getFavorites
methods.description: Returns a set of favorite product IDs.

methods.name: ShopRepository.observeFavorites
methods.description: Provides a LiveData for favorite product IDs.

methods.name: ShopRepository.loadCatalogPreferences
methods.description: Loads persisted catalog preferences with defaults.

methods.name: ShopRepository.saveCatalogPreferences
methods.description: Persists user catalog preferences.

methods.name: ShopRepository.getCatalogFirstPage
methods.description: Fetches the first page of catalog products based on query, with simulated delay.

methods.name: ShopRepository.getCatalogNextPage
methods.description: Fetches the next page for existing query, or resets if query has changed, with simulated delay.

methods.name: ShopRepository.buildCatalogFilteredSorted
methods.description: Filters and sorts products based on query parameters.

methods.name: ShopRepository.relevanceScore
methods.description: Computes a relevance score for a product based on search query and product attributes.

methods.name: ShopRepository.publishCart
methods.description: Updates the LiveData with current cart state and persists to local storage.

methods.name: ShopRepository.publishFavorites
methods.description: Updates the LiveData with current favorites state and persists.

methods.name: ShopRepository.CartItem
methods.description: Represents a cart item with product details and quantity.
